name: Condo Function Rooms
h1: Condo function room parties, transformed in an afternoon.
metaDescription: Hosting a birthday party in a condo function room in Singapore? OurKampung transforms condo function rooms with full styling, setup and teardown — hassle-free.
intro: A condo function room is one of the easiest, most affordable places to host a children's party — but a bare room needs styling to feel special. That's exactly what we do: we transform your function room with a complete setup, work within your condo's rules and time windows, and clear everything before your booking ends. All you book is the room; we handle the rest.
highlights: Complete styling of a bare function room, backdrop to tables
Setup and teardown within your booking window and house rules
Décor, cake, entertainment and catering coordinated together
Liaison with your condo management on access and timing

faqs.q: Can you set up and clear within our function room booking slot?
faqs.a: Yes — we plan our setup and teardown to fit your booking window, and we'll confirm timings with your management so there are no surprises.

faqs.q: Do you work within condo house rules?
faqs.a: Always. Tell us any restrictions — on adhesives, noise, or timing — and we'll style within them.

faqs.q: Is a function room cheaper than a party venue?
faqs.a: Usually, yes — it's why so many families choose them. You get an affordable space, and our styling makes it feel like a proper party.

name: At Home
h1: Parties at home, the comfiest kind of magic.
metaDescription: Hosting a kids' party at home in Singapore? OurKampung styles and runs at-home children's parties in HDB flats and condos — full setup, teardown and coordination.
intro: Home is often the loveliest place for a young child's party — familiar, comfortable, and easy for little ones and naps. We make it effortless: we assess your space, style it to feel genuinely special, and coordinate cake, entertainment and food, then clear everything away so your home is left exactly as we found it. All the warmth of home, none of the mess.
highlights: Setups designed to fit HDB flats and condo living spaces
Space-smart styling that feels special without crowding the room
Cake, entertainment and catering coordinated together
Full teardown — your home left just as it was

faqs.q: Will a full setup fit in an HDB flat?
faqs.a: Yes — we design setups to suit the space you have, making it feel special without overwhelming the room. Share a photo of your space and we'll plan around it.

faqs.q: Do you clean up and remove everything afterwards?
faqs.a: We do — full teardown is included, and we leave your home exactly as we found it.

faqs.q: Can you keep noise and mess manageable for neighbours?
faqs.a: Of course. We plan tidy, considerate setups and can suggest quieter entertainment options for apartment living.
